1.consolidated_definition: Cama de una plaza. Cama para una sola persona. Anglicismo híbrido, usual. Cada trailer tiene nevera, estufa, microondas, utensilios de cocina, aire acondicionado, 1 cama queen, 1 litera con dos camas twin y el comedor se convierte en otra cama twin (ClasificadosOnline.com, 28-03-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Bed in a plaza. Single-person bed. Hybrid Anglicism, commonly used. Each trailer has a refrigerator, stove, microwave, kitchen utensils, air conditioning, 1 queen-sized bed, 1 bunk with two twin beds, and the dining area converts into another twin bed.
